description: This file defines types and functions related to fetching resources in a browser testing environment. It provides a way to obtain a fetch function that works with different implementations, including mocking and cache busting for tests.

methods.name: function isUsableFetch(value: unknown): value is FetchLike { isUsableFetch
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a value is a usable fetch-like function, i.e., a function that does not have a 'mock' property.

methods.name: export function getBrowserTestFetch(): BrowserTestFetch { getBrowserTestFetch
methods.description: Returns a fetch implementation suitable for testing, attempting to use 'undici' or falling back to global fetch. It also un-mocks 'undici' when applicable.

ctags.name: BrowserTestFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export type BrowserTestFetch = (input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;$/

ctags.name: FetchLike
ctags.pattern: /^type FetchLike = ((input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) & {$/

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^  const { fetch } = require("undici") as typeof import("undici");$/

ctags.name: vitest
ctags.pattern: /^  const vitest = (globalThis as { vi?: { doUnmock?: (id: string) => void } }).vi;$/
